reference.note: The local .local snapshot remains alpha.1 and was not edited or used as the alpha.4 runtime. Alpha.4 source audit used an external cleanable checkout.

upstreamReview.runtimeDecision: alpha.4 is the sole main development runtime. The official 242-package public npm family is exact-version and integrity pinned; alpha.3 is not retained as a compatibility path.
upstreamReview.ownershipImpact: Agent hooks, llm/stream, tools/pre-execute, SessionEvent.ignorable, JSONL persistence, RemoteError/controllers, shipped presets, openai-codex authorization, usage, compaction, cancel, history pagination, Inspector eventSource and AppFrame/details seams remain compatible. Alpha.4 separates Session event sequence and log offsets, removes the session.events getter in favor of snapshotEvents(), converges Subagent followup/report on adjacent send_message, removes the public tool-subagent-report and code-runtime-python packages, omits workflow from PTC, enables web fetch in base/headless/sdk, and validates configured provider headers. Aezy migrated its three public Session read seams without copying upstream kernels.
